definitions.explanation: The fee charged for staying overnight at a hotel, inn, or other lodging facility.

examples.japanese: {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}には{朝食|ちょうしょく}が{含|ふく}まれています。
examples.english: Breakfast is included in the accommodation fee.

examples.japanese: {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}は1{泊|ぱく}1{万円|まんえん}だ。
examples.english: The accommodation fee is 10,000 yen per night.

examples.japanese: {繁忙期|はんぼうき}は{宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}が{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: Accommodation fees go up during the busy season.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {宿泊|しゅくはく} (lodging, staying overnight) + {料|りょう} (fee).

SYNONYMS:
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}: accommodation cost/expense
- {室料|しつりょう}: room charge
- {部屋代|へやだい}: room rate (colloquial)

INCLUSIONS/EXCLUSIONS:
- {素泊|すど}まり: room only (no meals)
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き: with breakfast
- {二食付|にしょくつ}き: with two meals (dinner and breakfast)
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き: with dinner

RELATED TERMS:
- {宿泊税|しゅくはくぜい}: accommodation tax
- サービス{料|りょう}: service charge
- {入湯税|にゅうとうぜい}: bathing tax (hot spring areas)

PRICING MODELS:
- {一人|ひとり}{当|あ}たり: per person
- {一部屋|ひとへや}{当|あ}たり: per room
- 1{泊|ぱく}: per night
